args.summary: Generated and validated a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of the three-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed box girder (36+48+36 m), with two-bearing support lines, PTFE sliding bearings at abutments and Pier 2, a fixed plain elastomeric bearing line at Pier 1, and the specified twin-column piers. Main-girder section: A=8.417 m², I=7.188 m⁴; self-weight=218.842 kN/m. Modal frequencies: 2.980, 4.761, and 5.479 Hz; JTG D60 impact factor μ=0.1772. Model generation passed L1 topology, L2 code, and L3 mechanics checks. Reported peak lane-load moments: +14,356.6 kN·m and −11,479.9 kN·m. Self-weight midspan moments: 15,572.7, 23,421.7, and 15,727.2 kN·m.
